run.change_description: fix(vercel): Fix ISR path rewrite to prevent 404

summary.intent: Restore ISR-served routes (currently 404) by letting the ISR function take the real path from the `x_astro_path` query parameter, without undoing the secret-only path override added in #15959.
summary.issue_fit: Partial — no linked issue; the PR text is the only intent source. The ISR 404 fix is plausible in code, but the change silently reverses #15959's trusted-secret guarantee.

ambiguities.term: Prior approval of the merged pull request
readings: Princesseuh's empty-body approval accepted the whole diff, including the header-keyed override
The approval addressed only the ISR 404 fix; it left no comment on path-override trust, so it accepts nothing about it
ambiguities.applied: The second reading: approval accepts only what the review addressed, and no inline comment touched path-override trust.

ambiguities.term: Whether `x-vercel-isr` and the function URLs are reachable by an untrusted client
readings: Vercel strips a client-sent `x-vercel-isr` and does not expose `/_render` or `/_isr` directly, so the override is unreachable
Vercel forwards the client header, or exposes the function URLs, so any client can trigger the override
ambiguities.applied: The second reading: the entrypoint authenticates neither the header nor the query, #15959 treated direct function access as exploitable, and `_isr` needs no header spoofing; platform behaviour could not be checked offline.

findings.title: Do not trust a client-settable header to unlock the path override
findings.trigger: A client calls the `_isr` function URL, or `_render` with `x-vercel-isr: 1`, with `?x_astro_path=/protected/route` and no middleware secret.
findings.impact: The shared entrypoint rewrites `url.pathname` and renders that route while edge middleware never sees the real path, reopening the auth bypass #15959 closed for `isr.exclude` routes and every route in non-ISR builds.
findings.change: In `packages/integrations/vercel/src/serverless/entrypoint.ts`, honor the query override only in the `_isr` bundle via a build-time flag, or authenticate the rewrite, instead of keying on a request header. Add a test sending the query with `x-vercel-isr: 1` to `_render` that expects it ignored.
findings.source: Commit 335a20416 (#15959) changeset: override values apply only when the trusted middleware secret is present.
